en:
Before the Mouri Army's onslaught,
the Takeda Army was powerless.
The battle ended with the suicide
of Takeda Nobushige, and the
Aki-Takeda clan perished here...

Go to the Living Quarters, Retainers' Hall
and Council Chamber

note: Retainer 8 is the Kobayakawa branch-house envoy.

en:
Hear the retainers' views, then go to
the Living Quarters

The Mouri and the other local lords
of Aki and Bingo on the Ouchi side
joined Ouchi Yoshitaka's army.
Sweeping on, they took the Amago
outpost Akana Castle and, led by
Kikkawa Okitsune, invaded Izumo.
Before besieging Gassan-Toda,
Yoshitaka convened his generals.

note: Scene menu (limit 72 px): 'Talk to generals' is 80 px. Earlier slices use 'See lords' / 'See vassals' for the same pattern. 0.2.14: written in full, since the scene-goal box now fits the English text (the shortened form was for the 8 px per character box).
